items.title: Tracking cocoa may be just the beginning for PwC, Merck, Hashgraph provenance system
items.summary: The firms say their combination of physical authentication, digital traceability and enterprise process design has no precedent in supply chains, and cocoa is just the start.

items.title: Ethereum commits to letting users pay gas fees without having to hold ETH
items.summary: The Frame Transactions feature was locked into the Hegotá upgrade last month, and Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin says the work has moved quickly since.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation names 2 ‘must ship’ EIPs for Hegotá upgrade
items.summary: Ethereum’s Hegotá upgrade will center on FOCIL and Frame Transactions as developers weigh dozens of other proposed changes for inclusion.

items.title: Bitcoin sidechain Liquid pauses after purported ‘white hats’ withdraw $320M in BTC
items.summary: The actors told Blockstream they would return most of the 4,000 BTC after the Elements vulnerability is patched across the network.

items.title: Live updates: Yen rally and rising bond yields pressure bitcoin and risk assets
items.summary: Bitcoin, gold and technology stocks fall as the yen rallies, while oil prices and government bond yields climb globally.

items.title: Ledger CTO urges AI bug hunter responsibility, warns against ‘attention farming’
items.summary: Ledger and Trezor said researchers have a responsibility to publish their findings if vendors fail to fix bugs within an agreed disclosure window.

items.title: New Bitcoin whales spark sell-side risk as unrealized gains hit $9B
items.summary: Unrealized gains by whale speculators hit their highest levels on record last week, per data going back to 2016.

items.title: Satoshi-era Bitcoin wakes after 16 years of dormancy as 600 BTC moves
items.summary: Whale Alert identified 12 mining rewards totaling 600 BTC that moved after 16 years of dormancy, with the onchain tracking platform finding no connection to Satoshi Nakamoto.

items.title: Tether-backed Orionx to shut down after audit flags $7M custody gap
items.summary: Tether-backed Orionx is permanently closing after an audit found more than $7 million in customer assets had moved to wallets outside its custody.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs are still $1 billion shy of breaking even in 2026
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 8, 2026

items.title: How Curve's soft liquidation model lets borrowers survive market drawdowns
items.summary: Data tracked by lending platform Curve data tracked 704 soft-liquidation instances lasting a median 14.5 days, showing how some DeFi loans can survive for weeks after entering the 'danger zone.'

items.title: Cronos executes controversial blockchain rollback to recover crypto worth $111 million
items.summary: Validators rolled back nearly two hours of blockchain history to recover user assets. But the attackers still managed to get away with $9.19 million before Cronos halted the network.

items.title: Bitcoin slips to $78,800 as BNB and DeFi tokens buck the selloff
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.42% since midnight UTC to $78,874, but the CoinDesk 20 rose 0.2% and the memecoin index gained 0.41% as BNB Chain tokens rallied.

items.title: Stablecoins could save South Korean merchants up to $3.8 billion a year, budget office says
items.summary: South Korea’s budget office warned that stablecoin adoption could reduce banks' roles as credit intermediaries and potentially destabilize token pegs during mass redemptions.

items.title: Bit2Me sets up specialized unit to help law enforcement track down crypto assets
items.summary: The unit formalizes past operations, building on 1.5 million euros in seized crypto the exchange processed in 2025 for agencies including Interpol and Europol.

items.title: Hunter Biden wants to launch a LAPTOP memecoin. Crypto traders hate it already
items.summary: Kraken deleted a promotional post after backlash, while a media group named in the token's distribution publicly distanced itself from the project.

items.title: Bitcoin’s golden cross is here
items.summary: A golden cross has triggered on bitcoin's daily price chart, indicating a potential long-term bullish trend ahead.

items.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest
items.summary: Supposed whitehat hackers behind Sunday’s Liquid Network breach have returned 3,400 of the 4,000 BTC they took, but nearly $47 million in bitcoin is still outstanding.

items.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%
items.summary: Every major token fell on Tuesday, though most keep weekly gains, with traders pricing a 60% chance of a Fed hike next week.

items.title: Circle to acquire Tazapay to expand USDC cross-border payments
items.summary: Tazapay processes $25 billion in annualized volume and offers payout rails across 100-plus markets, extending Circle’s USDC payments reach.
